name: Shield
summary: A reaction that wraps you in an invisible barrier, raising your AC until your next turn.

castingTime.trigger: when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell

stats.effect: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from *Magic Missile*.
